14b_vs_14f.test: McNemar's exact test (binomial form, two-sided, on paired binary correctness)
14b_vs_14f.applies_to: binary correct/incorrect per case, NOT the 3-class SUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED/UNGROUNDED label
14b_vs_14f.note: Computed over a 101-case synthetic benchmark. This is a descriptive, paired-by-case statistical test, not a claim of clinical significance or real-world generalizability.
